If you would like to participate in this meeting, you can participate via the following options:

1. VIEW THE MEETING ONLINE AT : https://youtube.com/@SouthGateCA90280
Please allow up to 24 hours after the meeting for the archive to be available.
2. PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING by emailing the City Clerk at:
yglaze@sogate.org no later than 4:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please write "Public
Comment" in the subject line.
3. ATTEND THE MEETING IN PERSON

*The disruption in service of any alternative method does not prelude the City Council or other
legislative body from taking further action and moving forward on the agenda.

Meeting Schedule

The regular meetings of the City Council are held on the second and fourth Tuesday of each month,
closed session business will usually commence at 5:30 p.m., when scheduled, and general business

  1
 session will commence at 6:30 p.m.

Brown Act

Agendas are drafted to accurately state what the legislative body is being asked to consider. The
legislative body can take action on "all items" listed on the agenda and be in compliance with the open
meeting laws. Under the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the
agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The governing body may direct
staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future meeting.

City's Vision Statement

We envision a thriving, safe and inclusive community where everyone has the opportunity to access
exceptional services, education and support to be resilient and live full, vibrant lives.

Public Communications

Public Comments on agenda items are limited to three (3) minutes. All comments are to be addressed
directly to the Agency Members not to the members of the public.

 GENERAL NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC

The City Council adopted new rules relating to the conduct of the public meetings, proceedings, and
business in the City of South Gate on July 12, 2022, (Resolution 2022-38-CC) and go into effect on
August 1, 2022. Resolution #2022-38-CC is available at the City Clerk’s Office.

MEETING SCHEDULE

Regular meetings of the City Council are held on the second and fourth Tuesday of each month, closed
session meetings will commence at 5:30 p.m. unless posted otherwise on its agenda. The regular City
Council meetings will commence at 6:30 p.m. Agendas are available at the following locations: City Clerk
Office, Public Notice Boards at City Hall, and on the City’s web page at https://www.cityofsouthgate.org

The Public can sign up to receive automatic notices of postings of agendas for the City Council or any
other Commission or Board of the City of South Gate. Visit the City webpage and click on the Agenda &
Minutes icon. That will take you the page where an individual can enter their email in the “Email
Updates” box to register.

PUBLIC COMMENT/PARTICIPATION

Any person may request to address a legislative body during a public meeting. The Presiding Officer will
call upon those present in the Council Chambers first. Speakers are limited to three (3) minutes on any
item listed on the agenda, including public hearings. Under Comments from the Audience portion,
speakers are also limited to a single three (3) minutes time limit. Comments from the Audience is initially
limited to 45 minutes at each meeting. Any speaker still wishing to speak, that did not speak, will have an
addition Comments from the Audience opportunity after the last business item is finished. The Presiding
Officer may extend the time limit as long as there is no objection from the City Council as a body. To
ensure that the public is able to participate, the City provides the opportunity to submit their comments in
person, email, mail. Methods of participation may be subject to change during other such times when a
State of Emergency, Health Order or State Executive Order limits in-person participation.

CURFEW

In absence of a motion duly adopted by majority vote of the City Council, the Presiding Officer may
adjourn the City Council meetings at 10:30 p.m. The Presiding Officer may ask the City Council if any
agenda items listed should be continued or dealt with during the meeting. For those items to be
continued, the City Council can direct the item be placed on the next City Council agenda or the current
meeting may be adjourned to a time certain at which time the meeting shall be reconvened as an
Adjourned Regular Meeting of the City Council and action upon the published agenda continued.

STAFF REPORTS

As a general rule, staff reports. or other written documentation are prepared/organized with respect to
each item of business listed on the agenda. Meeting agendas and staff reports are available at least 72-
hours prior to the scheduled regular City Council meeting and a minimum of 24-hours prior to a Special
City Council meeting. There are times when the City Council receives written material. revised material
after the posting of agendas, these materials are become a public record and will be available for public
view within 72-hours after the meeting in which they were received. Those materials and any other public
document can be inspected in the City Clerk's Office located at 8650 California Avenue, South Gate.

SERVICES TO FACILITATE ACCESS TO PUBLIC MEETINGS

In compliance with the American with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in the
City Council Meetings, please contact the Office of the City Clerk. Notification 48 hours prior to the City
Council Meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility. For

  4
 further information, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 563-9510 or via email at
yglaze@sogate.org.

SUBJECT:  GIRL  SCOUT  GOLD  AWARD  PROJECT  PROPOSAL

PURPOSE:  To allow  Aalyah  Martinez  to replace  a drinking  fountain  at the Sports  Center  with
a bottle  filling  station.

RECOMMENDED  ACTIONS:  The City  Council  will  give staff direction  to:
  a.  Allow  Aalyah  Martinez  to complete  her Girl  Scout Gold  Award  Project  at the South  Gate
  Sports  Center  by replacing  a standard  drinking  fountain  with  a bottle  filling  station;  and
  b.  Authorizing  City  staff to assist her in this project  where  necessary.

FISCAL  IMPACT  :  None.  Ms.  Martinez  will  be raising  all the  funds  necessary  for  the
purchase  of the bottle  filling  station  and the installation.

BACKGROUND:  Ms.  Martinez  approached  the  Parks  &  Recreation  Department  with  this
request  to complete  her Girl  Scout  Gold  Award  Project  and staff believes  that the request  is a
good fit for the Sports  Center  and the fitness  crowd  that uses the facility.

Greetings  City Council,

My name is Aalyah  Martinez.  As a brief introduction,  I am a resident  of South Gate, a Senior
and Associate  Student Body President  of South Gate High  School,  Key Club President,  and
South Gate Girl Scout.

I am passionate  about taking  action against the inequalities  I see in my community.  Historically,
Southeast  Los Angeles  has struggled  with various  injustices  including  water quality  and water
access. Simultaneously,  Marine  ecosystems  face severe threats including  climate  change and
pollution.  I am coupling  my passion  and my academic  interests  in preserving  marine  ecosystems
through  my Gold Award  Project.  The Gold Award  is the highest  honor a Girl Scout can earn  by
implementing  a sustainable  project.  Only  5% of eligible  Girl Scouts achieve this award and I
intend  to join this esteemed cohoit.

For my Gold Award  project,  I propose  the installation  of a filtration  water bottle refillable  station
in the lieart of South Gate Park: The South Gate Sports Center. This resource  will  provide  the
community  access to clean drii'iking  water and encourage  the usage of refillable  water bottles
thus minimizing  plastic  waste. My project  would  raise awareness  about water ineqriality  while
promoting  conservation  and clean water standards.

I seek this council's  permission  to partner  on this important  community  project.  In addition  to
your permission,  I request the city of South Gate's support  in hosting  the station  in its Sports
Center, providing  the water for the system,  and minimal  biannual  maintenance.  I will  be
responsible  for fundraising  and securing  donations  for the water refillable  station.  Additionally,  I
seek to liost community  events geared towards  sustainability  and water equality.  With your
partnership,  I look forward  to making  a difference  in my  community  together.

I appreciate  your time.

Many  thanks,

Aalyah  Martinez

SUBJECT:  PRESENTATION  OF  CERTIFICATES  OF  APPRECIATION  TO  TEN
WELL-MAINT  AINED  HOMES  NOMINATED  BY  LOCAL  COMMUNITY  MEMBERS
AND  SELECTED  BY THE  CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE  PLANNING  COMMISSION

PURPOSE:  To recognize  ten (10) homes  selected  by the Planning  Commission  as awardees  of
the Home  Recognition  Program  ("Program").

RECOMMENDED  ACTIONS:  The  City  Council  will  consider  presenting  Certificates  of
Appreciation,  lawn  signs,  and azalea plants  to 10 awardees  selected  by the Planning  Commission
to be recognized  for their  efforts  in maintaining  and beautifying  their homes.

FISCAL  IMPACT:  Funds  in the amount  of $5 000 were  included  in the Fiscal  Year  2024/25
budget  for the Program.

ANALYSIS:  Tlie  Program  recognizes  residents  wlio  have  coi'nunitted  to  beauti'fying  and
maintaining  tlieir  liomes.  Many  attractive  liomes  in the City  inspire  other residents  while  raising
coini'nunity  pride  and spirit.  Tlie Program  will  liigliliglit  and recognize  these liomes  and motivate
otliers  to improve  their homes,  enhance  residential  neighborhoods,  and improve  the quality  of life
for  Sorith  Gate  residents.  Tlie  nominated  homes  are located  tl'iroughout  tlie  City  and  were
nominated  by homeowners,  residents,  or City  Staf'f; however,  most nominations  derived  from  tlie
priblic.

This year, 37 Home  Recognition  applications  were received  but only 21 met the Program  eligibility
requirements.  These homes  are located  throughout  the City  and were nominated  by homeowners,
residents,  or City  staff. The Program  will  highlight  and recognize  two liomes  from  each of the five
districts  to motivate  others  to improve  their homes,  thereby  enhancing  residential  neighborhoods
and improving  the quality  of life for South Gate residents.  The Program  has three components:  (1)
promotion  and nominations,  (2) selection  of awardees,  and (3) recognition  by the City  Council.

Below  is a description  of the Program:

  9
  Program  Outreach
 Tlie City  advertised  the Program  on the City's  website  and social media  accounts,  the South  Gate
 Chamber  of Coiui'nerce,  and the comi'nunity  social  media  accounts.

 Program  Procedures
  *  Application:  residents  and City  staff  were  encouraged  to submit  nominations  for homes
  deserving  recognition  via email  or in-person  at City  Hall.
  *  Eligibility:  City  staff verified  the eligibility  of all applications.  All nominees  must meet the
  eligibility  requirements,  a staff member  conducted  an assessment  from  a distance  and took
  photos  to present  to the Planning  Coini'nission.

  *  Selection  of Homes:  Per the City  Council's  direction,  the homes  were  selected  by the
  Planning  Commission.  The Program's  goal is to select  10 homes  to be recognizml  by the
  City  Council  each year.

 Eligibility
 For a resident/homeowner  to be eligible  to participate  in the Program,  the property  must not have
 any pending  Code  Enforcement,  Building  & Safety,  and Planning  Division  violations,  nor have
 any property  maintenance  issues  visible  from  the street  such  as trash  cans on the front  yard,
 inoperable  vehicles,  unpermitted  canopies,  and discarded  house items.

 Notifications
 The City  notified  the selected  nominees  and invited  them to the August  27, 2024,  City  Council
 meeting  to be recognized  by the City  Council.  During  the meeting,  the awardees  will:
  *  Be recognized  by the City  Council  and receive  a Certificate  of Appreciation.
  @  Receive  a lawn  sign to be displayed  on their  front  lawn.
  *  Receive  an azalea plant.
